bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

budget_rule: build() is bounded so a resident can invoke it as a unit. Specimens it did not reach are named rather than silently omitted, and a prior verdict is carried forward rather than dropped.
claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement.
gaps_closed: nothing recomputed specimen hashes offline; readiness rested on size checks
modellake_authority: ModelLake owns specimens. This module opens them read-only, never writes into the lake, and never edits a manifest or a seal. The verdict lives in the sidecar partition.
negative_findings: a file with no .metadata sidecar cannot be verified offline at any effort
this does not make ModelLake wrong: its seals already say MANIFEST_ONLY
purpose: Earn whole-tree specimen verification offline from the HuggingFace .metadata digests, or state precisely which files cannot be verified.
recovered_implementation: ModelLake manifests report n_sha256_verified vs n_size_only_verified
each specimen carries MODEL_LAKE_SPECIMEN_SEAL.json, currently MANIFEST_ONLY

resident_callable.fails_closed: SpecimenError on an absent specimen; MISMATCH is CORRUPT, never rounded
resident_callable.workunit: one unit per specimen; CPU_VERIFY lane; genuinely long-running

alternatives.hypothetical: every published digest matched the hash recomputed here

confidence.about: whether the recorded probe entails the claim — not whether the world is that way for reasons this probe did not test
confidence.would_lower: a demonstration that the observation is consistent with the claim being false
confidence.would_raise: independent replication of the same probe

verification_rule: VERIFIED means the hash was recomputed here and matched a published digest. Size agreement is not verification. A specimen is WHOLE_TREE_VERIFIED only when every file carried a digest and every one matched; a single undigested file yields PARTIAL_NO_REMOTE_DIGEST.
